ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are concentrated at the upper-outer margins of both lobes. These regions transition into a dense field of small, discrete white circular blobs (mottling) against a black background toward the center. Distinct vertical white streaks are present on the lower portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of roughly 120 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-8 pixels. The right distal tip exhibits a more pronounced, jagged irregularity compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a convex sweep from the central notch to the tips. Outer leading edges show a tight convex curve returning to the waterline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distribution of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, typically 5-15 pixels in diameter, localized within the dark-pigmented central and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several vertical, high-intensity linear marks on the lower left lobe, ranging from 30 to 70 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (consistent with barnacle attachment sites) and distinct vertical rake marks on the lower left lobe. Small irregular protrusion on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'fringe-like' vertical white striping pattern localized to the lower-left margin of the fluke.
